context: Sho and Hina enjoy summer fruit.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、本当、夏の果物、美味しい。
lines.en: Sho, summer fruit is really so delicious.
lines.style: Bright, genuine child's voice with an open attack. Warm appreciation threading through each word. Soft and natural, no performance—just real happiness shared aloud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, quiet voice. Steady warmth beneath the simplicity. A six-year-old's genuine agreement—unhurried, genuine, matching her energy without trying.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 一緒に、本当、嬉しい、本当に。
lines.en: Being together like this—I'm really happy.
lines.style: Child's voice opens with soft emphasis on togetherness. Tender throughout, with a slight rise at the end—not questioning, but inviting agreement. Real childish warmth, unguarded.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet certainty from a small voice. Warm, almost solemn in its sincerity. No performance—just a six-year-old stating something he knows to be true.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Child's voice softens even further. Tender closing, almost vulnerable in its honesty. Warm but not exuberant—a genuine expression of what she feels, offered quietly.
